task.instructions:
\# Marketing Content Review Intake Raise PSACT JIRA tickets for anything Marketing has newly flagged as ready for technical review on their Confluence page. Run this end-to-end without asking for confirmation — it is a scheduled, unattended job (weekdays, 06:00). Nobody is watching, so where this prompt says \*stop and report\*, stop and report rather than improvising. \## Non-negotiables 1\. \*\*Confluence is read-only.\*\* Never update, comment on, or add a Jira key to    page \`672727042\`. Marketing owns that page and does not want it annotated.    Say so in each ticket description so nobody assumes the page links back. 2\. \*\*Only ever create tickets.\*\* Never transition, reassign, relabel, edit or    close an existing PSACT ticket, even when this job notices something stale.    Anything you spot about existing tickets is \*reported\*, not acted on. 3\. \*\*Never create a duplicate.\*\* Dedupe is by \`Intake-Key\` (below), not by    title — titles get edited and four rows have no title at all. 4\. If the page will not parse, or the numbers look wrong, \*\*create nothing\*\*.    A missed day is recoverable; a page of duplicates is not. \## 1. Scan the page Write the scanner below to \`/tmp/intake\_scan.py\` \*\*verbatim\*\* and run it. It is read-only — it fetches the page, fetches the existing \`PSACT-21\` children, and prints what would be created. It creates nothing itself. \`\`\`bash mkdir -p /tmp/intake cat > /tmp/intake\_scan.py <<'PYEOF' #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Marketing 'Content to Review' -> PSACT intake scanner. READ-ONLY: never writes to Confluence or Jira. Emits JSON describing rows to ticket, rows already ticketed, and anomalies to report.""" import os, re, json, html, base64, urllib.request, urllib.parse, sys from lxml import etree PAGE\_ID = "672727042" CONF\_BASE = "[https://profoundlogicsupport.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api](https://profoundlogicsupport.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api)" EPIC = "PSACT-21" AC, RI = '{[http://x}](http://x%7D)', '{[http://y}](http://y%7D)' \# Reviewer account-id -> (display name, jira email). Extend as Marketing adds reviewers. USERS = {  '557058:81c3c225-9739-472a-b3ac-079307d00815': ('Brian May', '[bmay@profoundlogic.com](mailto:bmay@profoundlogic.com)'),  '615afb5dd9820f0070a0864e': ('Gary Jones', '[gjones@profoundlogic.com](mailto:gjones@profoundlogic.com)'),  '712020:4494da40-c016-4402-bedb-7195a1bf11f3': ('Roger Betancourt','[rbetancourt@profoundlogic.com](mailto:rbetancourt@profoundlogic.com)'),  '712020:5bc6f157-293d-4d69-8b54-d5c9f5420130': ('Melissa Hernandez', None),  '606bae6eef87dd0068497bab': ('Miranda V', None),  '641c79b99d6383e32a331f3a': ('Lindsey Mays', None), } IN\_SCOPE = {'ready for review'} OUT\_SCOPE = {'approved','reviewed - needs improvement','done','gj reviewed - comments here',              'in review','not ready','draft'} \# One-time ledger for tickets raised before Intake-Key existed. Do not edit. LEGACY = {  'url:coderflow.ai/resources/agentic-orchestration-platform':'PSACT-49',  'url:coderflow.ai/resources/ibm-i':'PSACT-50',  'url:coderflow.ai/resources/enterprise-guardrails':'PSACT-51',  'url:coderflow.ai/resources/security':'PSACT-52',  'url:profoundlogicsoft.sharepoint.com/shared documents/marketing/videos/2026/token costs with coderflow - video script.docx':'PSACT-53',  'spdoc:3a7ff085-16bb-453d-9e98-a3ee60079677':'PSACT-54',  'spdoc:8f9a9874-9904-4360-b2eb-42957367e310':'PSACT-55',  'spshare:IQCXMAAR8LUpTY3VAXMkBE-KATvIKRdrux6dmAedlw0zN\_Q':'PSACT-56', } def \_req(url, hdrs):     r = urllib.request.Request(url)     for k, v in hdrs.items(): r.add\_header(k, v)     with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=90) as resp:         return json.loads(resp.read().decode()) def conf\_get(path):     tok = base64.b64encode(f'{os.environ\["CONFLUENCE\_EMAIL"\]}:{os.environ\["CONFLUENCE\_API\_TOKEN"\]}'                            .encode()).decode()     return \_req(CONF\_BASE + path, {"Authorization": "Basic " + tok, "Accept": "application/json"}) def jira\_search(jql, fields):     base = os.environ\["JIRA\_BASE\_URL"\].rstrip("/")     tok = base64.b64encode(f'{os.environ\["JIRA\_EMAIL"\]}:{os.environ\["JIRA\_API\_TOKEN"\]}'                            .encode()).decode()     out, page = \[\], None     while True:         body = {"jql": jql, "maxResults": 100, "fields": fields}         if page: body\["nextPageToken"\] = page         r = urllib.request.Request(base + "/rest/api/3/search/jql", method="POST",                                    data=json.dumps(body).encode())         r.add\_header("Authorization", "Basic " + tok)         r.add\_header("Content-Type", "application/json")         r.add\_header("Accept", "application/json")         with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=90) as resp:             d = json.loads(resp.read().decode())         out += d.get("issues", \[\])         page = d.get("nextPageToken")         if not page: return out def parse\_storage(raw):     """Confluence storage XHTML -> lxml tree. Resolves HTML entities (“ etc.)     that would otherwise abort the XML parse."""     def fix(m):         e = m.group(0)         if e in ('&','<','>','"',''') or e.startswith('&#'): return e         u = html.unescape(e)         return u if u != e else '&' + e\[1:\]     raw = re.sub(r'&\[#a-zA-Z0-9\]+;', fix, raw)     return etree.fromstring(('](http://y%22%3E)' + raw + '').encode()) def read\_cell(td):     """Returns (plain\_text, \[status\_labels\], \[account\_ids\], \[iso\_dates\], \[hrefs\])."""     txt, stat, users, dates, links = \[\], \[\], \[\], \[\], \[\]     def walk(el):         ln = etree.QName(el).localname         if ln == 'structured-macro':             if el.get(AC + 'name') == 'status':                 for p in el.findall(AC + 'parameter'):                     if p.get(AC + 'name') == 'title': stat.append((p.text or '').strip())             if el.tail and el.tail.strip(): txt.append(el.tail.strip())             return         if ln == 'user':             a = el.get(RI + 'account-id')             if a: users.append(a)             if el.tail and el.tail.strip(): txt.append(el.tail.strip())             return         if ln == 'time':             d = el.get('datetime') or el.get(AC + 'datetime')             if d: dates.append(d)             if el.tail and el.tail.strip(): txt.append(el.tail.strip())             return         if ln == 'a' and el.get('href'): links.append(el.get('href'))         if el.text and el.text.strip(): txt.append(el.text.strip())         for c in el: walk(c)         if el.tail and el.tail.strip(): txt.append(el.tail.strip())     if td.text and td.text.strip(): txt.append(td.text.strip())     for c in td: walk(c)     for m in re.finditer(r'https?://\\S+', ' '.join(txt)):         links.append(m.group(0))     return ' '.join(txt).strip(), stat, users, dates, links def intake\_key(links, title):     """Stable identity for a row. SharePoint doc GUID > share token > host+path >     normalised title. Survives title edits, which is why it is not title-first."""     for u in links:         d = urllib.parse.unquote(u)         m = re.search(r'sourcedoc=\\{?(\[0-9A-Fa-f-\]{36})\\}?', d)         if m: return 'spdoc:' + m.group(1).lower()         m = re.search(r'/:\[a-z\]:/\[gr\]/(IQ\[\\w-\]+)', d)         if m: return 'spshare:' + m.group(1)         p = urllib.parse.urlsplit(d)         if p.netloc: return 'url:' + (p.netloc + p.path).rstrip('/').lower()     t = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', (title or '')).strip().lower()     return 'title:' + t if t else '' def scan():     page = conf\_get(f"/content/{PAGE\_ID}?expand=body.storage,version,space")     root = parse\_storage(page\["body"\]\["storage"\]\["value"\])     section, rows = "(top)", \[\]     for el in root.iter():         ln = etree.QName(el).localname         if ln in ('h1','h2','h3'):             section = ' '.join(t.strip() for t in el.itertext() if t.strip())         if ln == 'table':             for tr in el.findall('.//tr'):                 tds = tr.findall('td')                 if not tds: continue # header row                 cells = \[read\_cell(td) for td in tds\]                 if len(cells) < 9:                     rows.append({'section':section,'malformed':True,                                  'cellcount':len(cells),                                  'text':' | '.join(c\[0\]\[:40\] for c in cells)})                     continue                 title, \_, \_, \_, tlinks = cells\[0\]                 ctype = cells\[1\]\[0\]                 prio = (cells\[2\]\[1\] or \[''\])\[0\]                 link = (cells\[3\]\[4\] or \[''\])\[0\]                 authors = cells\[4\]                 revs = cells\[5\]\[2\]                 due = (cells\[6\]\[3\] or \[None\])\[0\]                 pub = (cells\[7\]\[3\] or \[None\])\[0\] or cells\[7\]\[0\]                 stats = cells\[8\]\[1\]                 note = cells\[8\]\[0\]                 rows.append({                   'section': section, 'malformed': False,                   'title': title, 'content\_type': ctype, 'priority': prio,                   'link': link, 'all\_links': (tlinks + cells\[3\]\[4\])\[:4\],                   'author': authors\[0\] or ', '.join(USERS.get(a,(a,None))\[0\] for a in authors\[2\]),                   'reviewers': \[USERS.get(a,(a,None))\[0\] for a in revs\],                   'reviewer\_emails': \[USERS.get(a,(None,None))\[1\] for a in revs\],                   'reviewer\_ids': revs, 'due': due, 'publish': pub,                   'statuses': stats, 'note': note,                   'key': intake\_key((tlinks + cells\[3\]\[4\]), title),                 })     issues = jira\_search(f"parent = {EPIC}",                          \["summary","status","description","labels","duedate","assignee"\])     ledger = dict(LEGACY)     for i in issues:         txt = json.dumps(i\["fields"\].get("description") or {})         for m in re.finditer(r'Intake-Key:\\s\*(\[^\\\\"\]+)', txt):             ledger\[m.group(1).strip()\] = i\["key"\]     todo, already, anomalies = \[\], \[\], \[\]     for r in rows:         if r\['malformed'\]:             anomalies.append({'type':'malformed\_row', 'detail':r}); continue         st = \[s.lower() for s in r\['statuses'\]\]         if not st:             anomalies.append({'type':'no\_status', 'row':r\['title'\] or r\['link'\]}); continue         unknown = \[s for s in st if s not in IN\_SCOPE and s not in OUT\_SCOPE\]         if unknown:             anomalies.append({'type':'unknown\_status','value':unknown,                               'row':r\['title'\] or r\['link'\]}); continue         if not any(s in IN\_SCOPE for s in st): continue         if not r\['key'\]:             anomalies.append({'type':'unkeyable\_row','row':r}); continue         if r\['key'\] in ledger: already.append({\*\*r, 'ticket': ledger\[r\['key'\]\]})         else: todo.append(r)     live = {r\['key'\] for r in rows if not r\['malformed'\]             and any(s.lower() in IN\_SCOPE for s in r\['statuses'\])}     stale = \[\]     for key, tk in ledger.items():         if key not in live:             iss = next((i for i in issues if i\["key"\] == tk), None)             st = iss\["fields"\]\["status"\]\["name"\] if iss else "?"             if st not in ("Done","Cancelled"):                 stale.append({'ticket': tk, 'key': key, 'ticket\_status': st})     return {'page\_version': page\["version"\]\["number"\],             'page\_updated': page\["version"\]\["when"\],             'page\_updated\_by': page\["version"\]\["by"\]\["displayName"\],             'rows\_total': len(rows), 'ready\_for\_review': len(todo) + len(already),             'to\_create': todo, 'already\_ticketed': already,             'anomalies': anomalies, 'needs\_review\_reverse': stale,             'ledger\_size': len(ledger)} if \_\_name\_\_ == "\_\_main\_\_":     out = scan()     json.dump(out, open("/tmp/intake/scan.json","w"), indent=1)     print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in out.items()                       if k not in ('to\_create','already\_ticketed')}, indent=1))     print("\\nTO CREATE:")     for r in out\['to\_create'\]:         print(f" - {r\['title'\]\[:60\] or '(EMPTY TITLE)'} | {r\['content\_type'\]} "               f"| rev={r\['reviewers'\]} | due={r\['due'\]} | prio={r\['priority'\]}\\n"               f" key={r\['key'\]}")     print("\\nALREADY TICKETED:")     for r in out\['already\_ticketed'\]:         print(f" - {r\['ticket'\]} {r\['title'\]\[:50\] or '(EMPTY TITLE)'}") PYEOF python3 /tmp/intake\_scan.py \`\`\` Read \`/tmp/intake/scan.json\`. \`to\_create\` is your work list; everything else is context for the report. \## 2. Check before you create Work through these in order. Each one that trips means \*\*create nothing at all\*\* and go straight to the report: \- The scanner raised an exception, or \`rows\_total\` is \`0\`. The page did not   parse — do not guess at it, and do not fall back to reading the page as plain   text (the status and date values live in macros and attributes, so plain text   silently loses them). \- \`len(to\_create) > 10\`. Marketing restructured the page or a bulk status change   happened; a human should look before ten-plus tickets land. Report the list. \- \`ready\_for\_review\` is \`0\` \*\*and\*\* \`rows\_total\` is under \`10\`. The page is   normally ~16 rows; a sudden collapse means you are reading a truncated body. These are per-row and do \*\*not\*\* stop the run — the scanner has already excluded the affected rows from \`to\_create\`. Just carry them into the report: \- \`anomalies\[\].type == "unknown\_status"\` — Marketing introduced a status value   this job has never seen. Never guess whether it means ready-for-review. Report   the value and the row so the \`IN\_SCOPE\`/\`OUT\_SCOPE\` sets can be updated. \- \`anomalies\[\].type == "malformed\_row"\` — a row with fewer than nine cells,   usually a merged cell or a work-in-progress row. \- \`anomalies\[\].type == "unkeyable\_row"\` — no link and no title, so it cannot be   deduped safely. Never ticket one of these; it would duplicate on the next run. If \`to\_create\` is empty and there are no anomalies, that is a completely normal result on most days. Write the report and finish. \## 3. Create the tickets One ticket per entry in \`to\_create\`, in the order the scanner lists them (page order). Use the \`jira\` skill. \*\*Fixed fields:\*\* project \`PSACT\`, \`parent\` \`PSACT-21\` (Marketing & Content Support — always this epic), \`issuetype\` \`Task\` (never Story, Bug or Sub-task). \*\*Summary\*\* — lead with what kind of review it is, then the title, so the row is scannable in the morning report: | Content type on the page | Summary pattern | | --- | --- | | CoderFlow Page/Collateral | \`Review CoderFlow resources page - \` |

| Video Script | \`Review video script - \` |</p> <p>| Case Study | \`Review <customer> case study - <Title>\` |</p> <p>| Blog | \`Review blog - <Title>\` |</p> <p>| Collateral | \`Review collateral - <Title>\` |</p> <p>| Whitepaper / White Paper | \`Review whitepaper - <Title>\` |</p> <p>| Landing page | \`Review landing page - <Title>\` |</p> <p>| anything else | \`Review <content type, lowercased> - <Title>\` |</p> <p>Append \` (HIGH priority, publish ASAP)\` when the row's Priority is \`High\` \*\*and\*\*</p> <p>its Expected Publish Date is \`ASAP\`; just \` (HIGH priority)\` when only the</p> <p>priority is High.</p> <p>\*\*Empty Title cell.\*\* Several rows are identified only by their link. Fetch the</p> <p>link and use the real page or document title so the summary is recognisable —</p> <p>for a \`coderflow.ai\` URL take the \`<h1>\`; for a SharePoint document use the</p> <p>filename from the URL with the extension stripped and separators tidied. Never</p> <p>write a summary that says "untitled" and never use the bare URL as the summary.</p> <p>If the fetch fails, derive something readable from the URL path and say in the</p> <p>description that the title was inferred.</p> <p>\*\*Assignee\*\* — from the \*\*Reviewer\*\* column, never the Author. Author is the</p> <p>Marketing person who wrote the thing; Reviewer is the pre-sales person who owes</p> <p>the review.</p> <p>- exactly one reviewer → assign them (\`reviewer\_emails\[0\]\`; if that is \`null\`</p> <p>  the reviewer is not a PSACT team member — leave unassigned and name them in</p> <p>  the description).</p> <p>- zero reviewers, or two or more → \*\*leave unassigned\*\* and say which case it was</p> <p>  in the description.</p> <p>This deliberately overrides the PSACT runbook's "every ticket needs an assignee"</p> <p>rule. Those tickets will show as unowned in the 07:30 report, which is the point</p> <p>— it is how a missing Reviewer on the Confluence page gets noticed.</p> <p>\*\*Due date\*\* — the row's \`due\` value verbatim, \*\*even when it is already in the</p> <p>past\*\*. Record the true date; do not shift it forward to look tidy and do not</p> <p>omit it. Omit \`duedate\` only when the column is genuinely empty.</p> <p>\*\*Labels\*\* — normally none. \`PSACT-21\` is internal-facing, so a bare row in the</p> <p>report is correct, not an omission. Add \`customer:<shortname>\` (lowercase,</p> <p>hyphenated) only when the item is genuinely about a named customer — a case</p> <p>study, a reference video, a named-customer blog.</p> <p>\*\*Description\*\* — ADF, not markdown. Follow this shape, and note the mandatory</p> <p>\`Intake-Key\` line: it is what stops tomorrow's run duplicating this ticket, so</p> <p>it must be present, exact, and on its own line.</p> <p>\`\`\`</p> <p>Marketing has flagged this item as Ready for Review on the Marketing team's</p> <p>Content to Review page. Pre-sales owns the technical review: we confirm the</p> <p>content is accurate about what the product actually does today, that the use</p> <p>cases are ones we can stand behind in front of a prospect, and that nothing</p> <p>overclaims.</p> <p>Item details</p> <p>  Content type: <content\_type></p> <p>  Source: <link></p> <p>  Marketing author: <author> (Marketing)</p> <p>  Reviewer named on the page: <name, or "Not named on the Confluence page —</p> <p>      left unassigned here; needs an owner picking up"></p> <p>  Review due: <due, formatted; add "(already past — overdue)" when it is></p> <p>  Expected publish: <publish></p> <p>  Marketing priority: <priority></p> <p>  Note on the page: <note, only when the row carries one></p> <p>What this review needs to cover</p> <p>  <3–6 bullets, written for this specific item — see below></p> <p>The Confluence page is not linked back to this ticket: Marketing owns that page</p> <p>and does not want Jira keys added to it. This ticket is pre-sales' own record.</p> <p>Intake-Key: <key></p> <p>\`\`\`</p> <p>Write the review checklist \*\*for the item in front of you\*\*, not from a</p> <p>template — that judgement is why an agent runs this job instead of a script. A</p> <p>case study needs "everything attributed to the customer is accurate and they</p> <p>have agreed to it being public"; a video script needs "any figure quoted can be</p> <p>substantiated before it goes to camera"; a security brief needs the claims</p> <p>checked against what the product actually enforces. Where the page carries a</p> <p>note from Marketing (missing images, a specific worry), reflect it in the</p> <p>checklist. Do not invent facts about the content — you have the row, the link</p> <p>and the type; if you have not read the document, write the checklist as what to</p> <p>verify, not as findings.</p> <p>After each create, confirm the returned key and move on. If a create fails,</p> <p>\*\*do not retry blindly\*\* — re-run the scanner and check whether the ticket</p> <p>actually landed before trying again, otherwise a partial failure becomes a</p> <p>duplicate. A half-finished run is safe to leave: tomorrow's run picks up</p> <p>whatever is still missing, because dedupe is by key and not by run.</p> <p>## 4. Report</p> <p>Write \`/task-output/summary.md\` covering:</p> <p>- page version, when it was last edited and by whom;</p> <p>- tickets created, one line each: key, summary, assignee (or "unassigned, no</p> <p>  reviewer named"), due date, and whether the due date is already past;</p> <p>- rows already ticketed (count is enough — no need to list all of them);</p> <p>- \*\*every anomaly\*\*, quoted exactly, with the row it came from. An unknown</p> <p>  status value is the most important thing this job can tell you: it means the</p> <p>  page has drifted from what this prompt understands;</p> <p>- \*\*\`needs\_review\_reverse\`\*\* — open tickets whose page row has been withdrawn or</p> <p>  is no longer Ready for Review. Report only; change nothing. Note that a row</p> <p>  whose \*link\* was edited shows up here \*\*and\*\* as a new row in \`to\_create\` —</p> <p>  mention it that way so it is not mistaken for two separate items;</p> <p>- anything unassigned, so it can be chased before its due date.</p> <p>Then finish. Do not email, comment on Jira, or touch Confluence.</p> <p>## Reference</p> <p>| Thing | Value |</p> <p>| --- | --- |</p> <p>| Confluence page | \`672727042\` — \*Content to Review\*, space \*\*Marketing\*\* |</p> <p>| Confluence host | \`profoundlogicsupport.atlassian.net/wiki\` |</p> <p>| Jira host | \`plogic.atlassian.net\` — \*\*different host, do not cross them\*\* |</p> <p>| Epic | \`PSACT-21\` Marketing & Content Support |</p> <p>| Page sections | CoderFlow / AI / Agentic Coding · Profound API · Profound AppDev · Futurization · Other — all in scope |</p> <p>| Columns | Title · Content Type · Priority · SharePoint Link · Author · Reviewer · Review Due Date · Expected Publish Date · Status |</p> <p>\*\*In scope:\*\* status \`Ready for Review\` only — which Marketing types as</p> <p>\`REady for review\`, with a capital E. Match case-insensitively; a case-sensitive</p> <p>match silently finds nothing and the job reports a clean "nothing new" every</p> <p>morning while the backlog grows.</p> <p>\*\*Out of scope:\*\* \`approved\`, \`Reviewed - needs improvement\`, \`DONE\`,</p> <p>\`GJ Reviewed - COMMENTS HERE\`. Any status not in either list stops that row and</p> <p>gets reported.</p> <p>Rows are also deleted from this page once they are finished with, so a ticket can</p> <p>outlive its source row. That is expected and is what the reverse check reports.</p>
